lines.text: What are you coming in with?
I'm coming in with neck pain since a car shunt on Monday morning.
No, sorry, I'm coming in with it since Sunday evening, Monday was when I went to the walk-in centre.
Any tingling in your arms or hands?
There's no tingling, and I've not lost any strength that I've noticed.
Let me have a look. Turning is limited both ways, but your arm reflexes and sensation are normal.
Can you just do the thing where you click it? I'm up for a crack if it helps.
I'd rather not manipulate a neck this soon after a crash, it might well settle with gentle movement first.
Turn your head gently side to side ten times every hour you're awake, and keep the warm compress on before bed.
